ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity pixels (white/light-gray) to 35% low-intensity pixels (black/dark-gray) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central-lateral areas of both lobes. Low-intensity dark regions form a central triangular wedge from the peduncle to the notch and high-density mottled blobs at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees. The notch depth accounts for roughly 12% of the visible vertical height along the fluke midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serrated boundary with pixel-amplitude variations of 10-20 pixels. The frequency of peaks increases towards the distal tips, creating a jagged saw-tooth topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: S-shaped trajectory; initial concave sweep originating at the median notch transitioning into a strong convex curve as it approaches the lateral lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast dark circular clusters (mottling) are distributed across the white lateral fields, with a high concentration of rosettes on the distal third of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the left lobe, intersecting the white pigmentation at roughly 45-degree angles relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular protrusions and high-contrast crusting on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, indicative of heavy barnacle colonization and secondary scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in pigmentation density, with the left lobe exhibiting a significantly higher frequency of focal dark spots and linear disruptions compared to the right lobe.
